mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${database}.cloud_report_results_v1 ( ts TIMESTAMP, message_id VARCHAR(128) COMPOSITE KEY, local_device_ids_json VARCHAR(8192), device_hashes_json VARCHAR(5000), cloud_device_id NCHAR(256), gateway_device_id NCHAR(256), status VARCHAR(32), published_at BIGINT, ack_at BIGINT, created_at BIGINT, completed_at BIGINT, attempts INT )
mapper.sql:
completed_at >= #{startTs} AND completed_at <= #{endTs}
AND device_hashes_json LIKE #{devicePattern}
mapper.select: SELECT message_id,local_device_ids_json,cloud_device_id,gateway_device_id,status, published_at,ack_at,created_at,completed_at,attempts FROM ${database}.cloud_report_results_v1 WHERE ORDER BY completed_at DESC, message_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ${database}.cloud_report_results_v1 WHERE AND status = 'ACK_CONFIRMED'
